title: "Seventeen Years of Chess Game"
next_chapter_hook: "Just as Chen Ji was about to counterattack using the rules of the chess game, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shook violently—someone was trying to forcibly read his memories."

text.content: "The golden light faded away, and the temperature of the Tianji Record Fragment was slowly subsiding. Chen Ji stood in place, his knuckles white from clenching. Seventeen years of memories flashed through his mind like a carousel. Master Mo's words 'you might not even finish one move' cut into his heart like a dull blade repeatedly. He never knew his life was a carefully orchestrated play, nor did he know that the seemingly omniscient existence was merely a slightly larger piece in the chess game."

"He took a deep breath and forced himself to calm down. Anger was the most useless emotion—it only made people show their flaws. Chen Ji self-deprecatingly tugged at the corner of his mouth—his first lesson as this 'waste' was endurance. But today's endurance was different from before. This time, he would settle this debt, with interest."

"He slowly closed his eyes, letting the flood of memories overwhelm him. It started at age seven, when he nearly fell off a cliff in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain and accidentally discovered a hundred-year-old lingzhi—that was the 'first bucket of gold' that changed his fate. Chen Ji remembered how ecstatic he was at the time, his hands trembling as he held the lingzhi. But now, looking back, the railing at the cliff edge had conveniently loosened the day before."

dialogue.content: "Loose railing, ripe lingzhi, conveniently passing by… Hmph, what a coincidence."

text.content: "At twelve, he obtained the first piece of the Tianji Record Fragment. Master Mo called it 'coincidental fortune' and 'heaven's favor.' Chen Ji believed it then, moved to tears. Now, thinking about it, the fragment appeared exactly in the mountain col he had to pass while herding sheep. The timing, not a single deviation."

"The memories continued surging. At fourteen, he 'accidentally' saved an outer disciple trapped by demonic beasts and gained access to the Scripture Library. At sixteen, he obtained a 'lost cultivation technique' in the secret realm, his strength soaring yet he deliberately suppressed his cultivation. Every time he thought it was his own good luck, heaven's blessing. Now he realized, even his 'luck' was arranged by others."

dialogue.content: "'So all these years, I thought I had everything calculated, but I was actually just following a script?'"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, a cold light flashing in his pupils. He punched the ancient pine beside him, the trunk trembling, leaves falling like scattered snow. Blood seeped through his knuckle skin, yet he felt nothing. Seventeen years,整整十七年. He thought he was walking alone in the darkness, but every step he took was actually on lines drawn by others."

"But what truly made him so angry he felt cold all over was not just the fact of being controlled. It was the information revealed in Master Mo's final words—'the chess player is not completely loyal.' What did this mean? It meant there was an even higher existence above Master Mo. And what was that existence's relationship with the Heavenly Eye?"

dialogue.content: "'Deep in memory, Master Mo once said: 'The Tianji Record is the chess game set by heaven's design. I am merely the acting chess player.''"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly understood something. Master Mo was the chess player, but the words 'acting chess player' indicated he was merely acting on behalf of some existence. Could that existence be the Heavenly Eye? And was Master Mo's various considerations for Chen Ji out of loyalty, or for some other hidden purpose?"

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji stood at the crossroads of fate. Seventeen years of puppet life made him furious, but it made him even more clear-headed. He needed to make a choice—"

choices.text: "Endure and lie in wait, secretly laying plans"
choices.description: "'Since the chess game still has seventy-two moves remaining, then turn the tables on their scheme and bury seeds of counterattack in corners they cannot see.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Obtain 'Chess Game Insight' state: Generate warning markers for all guidance from Master Mo'"
choices.risk_hint: "'If one's divergent intentions are detected, it may trigger early counterattack'"

A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth—since the other party liked watching a show, he would act it out for them. Act as a chess piece completely unaware of everything, act as an grateful inheritor. And in the shadows, he would place piece by piece, until he overturned the entire game."

choices.text: "'Proactively probe and find out the底牌'"
choices.description: "'Directly inquire the remnant will fragments of Master Mo within the Tianji Record, probing the boundaries of that 'higher existence.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Chess Game Truth·Fragment': Learn the general outline of the seventy-two move chess game'"
choices.risk_hint: "'May trigger the gaze of the Heavenly Eye'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji sank his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment, directly touching the will fragment that had not yet fully dissipated. His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable sharpness: 'Master Mo, I only want to ask one thing—is there a chess player beyond the chess game?'"

choices.description: "'Since he knows it is a chess game, study the rules of the chess game. Every rule has loopholes. Chen Ji will find them.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Tianji Record·Deep Permission': Can vaguely sense the existence of other Tianji Record holders'"

text.content: "Chen Ji sat cross-legged, fingers constantly tracing lines in the air. For seventeen years, he used the Tianji Record as a tool to calculate the future, yet never seriously considered—whether this 'tool' itself was also being calculated? What were the rules of the Tianji Record? How did the Heavenly Fate consumption mechanism operate? If he was a chess piece, then the Tianji Record Fragment was a cage—but a cage must have gaps in its bars."

"Night wind rose, stirring the frayed hem of Chen Ji's servant's robe. He stood at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, beneath his feet were yawning chasms of ten thousand zhang, behind him was the sect where he had lived for seventeen years. Here were the cliff where he 'coincidentally' found the lingzhi, the secret realm entrance he 'accidentally' entered, the countless places he 'conveniently' passed by. Now these places had all changed in his eyes—they were no longer symbols of blessed lands, but coordinates marked with traces of manipulation."

choice.prompt: "Memories flooded back like tides, and Chen Ji discovered a terrifying pattern—every 'opportunity' was followed by a 'calamity.' What did this mean?"

choices.text: "'Opportunities and calamities alternate, tempering the temperament'"
choices.description: "'Through repeated gains and losses, forge him into a person calm to the point of being near-heartless. What the chess player needs is not a genius, but a perfectly polished tool.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Chess Game Metaphor': Understand the true purpose of the chess player'"
choices.risk_hint: "'May shake one's sense of meaning in existence'"
choices.process_label: 陈机推断出执棋者的目的

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the laughter mournful and bitter. He was not a chosen genius, but a filtered tool. Every 'opportunity' was a reward, every 'calamity' was a punishment. Between rewards and punishments, his edges were ground smooth, his sharpness was reined in, his personality was reshaped. He learned endurance, calculation, never revealing joy or anger—these were exactly the 'qualities' the chess player wanted him to possess."

choices.description: "'A pure insect-raising tactic. Through constantly creating crises, force him to break through limits at the edge of life and death.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Extreme Breaker' title: Survival rate in all near-death states increased by 10%'"
choices.process_label: 陈机意识到自己被当作试验品

dialogue.content: "He remembered when he was fifteen, nearly dying under demonic beast claws. At sixteen, fighting blood battles against demonic cultivators in the secret realm for three days and three nights. And every 'accidental' sect mission—weren't they all nine deaths and one life? At the time he thought it was heaven's test, but now he understood it was just someone wanting to see how much hammering this repeatedly tempered iron embryo could withstand."

text.content: "Chen Ji closed his eyes, letting anger burn in his chest. He remembered every 'this is for your own good,' every 'the timing is not yet right,' every 'you will understand eventually' that Master Mo had said. Those words now sounded full of condescending pity. His seventeen years, living in a Truman World carefully designed by others, thinking he was the master of his fate."

"'But you miscalculated one thing.' Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'You thought you had honed me into a handy blade, but forgot one thing—a blade will cut back.' He opened his eyes, cold starlight reflected in his pupils, shining against the dawn light gradually brightening the horizon."

choice.prompt: "Chen Ji had figured everything out. Seventeen years of chess game, seventeen years of puppet life. But now, he decided to fight back. What should his first move be?"

choices.text: "'Exploit rule loopholes, reverse drain the羊毛'"

choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Heavenly Fate Thief' skill: Each foresight consumption reduced by 1 point (minimum 2 points)'"
choices.risk_hint: "'May be flagged by the rule system'"
choices.process_label: 陈机决定薅规则的羊毛

text.content: "A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. The consumption of Heavenly Fate was a rule, so he would study the rules. The Tianji Record giving him foresight ability was an 'investment,' so he would use that investment to leverage greater returns. The chess player wanted to use him, so he would be a greedy chess piece—within the scope allowed by the rules, squeeze every bit of benefit dry."

choices.text: "'Deliberately deviate from the script, plant seeds of variables'"
choices.description: "'What the chess player fears most is not a strong opponent, but unpredictable variables. He will be the sand that disrupts the chess game.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Chess Game Static' state: Chess player's foresight accuracy decreased by 15%'"
choices.process_label: 陈机决定做不可预测的变量

dialogue.content: "'You designed a seventeen-year script,' Chen Ji whispered to himself, 'so from today onward, I will be the actor who does not follow the script.' He didn't need to defeat the chess player, he only needed to make the chess game chaotic. When there are enough variables, when the chains of cause and effect are broken enough, the so-called chess game is nothing more than a candle guttering in the wind."

choices.text: "'Contact other 'chess pieces,' form a rebellion alliance'"
choices.description: "'The Heavenly Eye would not have only one chess piece. Those equally manipulated people might become the sharpest blade.'"
choices.visible_reward: "'Unlock 'Shared Fate': Can sense the existence of others related to the Tianji Record nearby'"
choices.process_label: 陈机考虑联络其他棋子

text.content: "A thought suddenly struck Chen Ji—the Heavenly Eye could select him, so it must have selected others. How many of those past 'prophets,' those beings guided by the Tianji Record, had awakened? How many were still immersed in the dream of being 'chosen ones'? He wanted to find them. Not for alliance, but to see clearly—whether the fates of rebels were even more tragic than his."

"The eastern horizon had begun to glow with the first light of dawn, a new day about to begin. Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly suppressing the churning anger in his chest. Seventeen years of chess game, he had lost completely. But it didn't matter, the chess game wasn't over yet. The chess player thought he was a docile chess piece, but didn't know that once a true chess piece discovers its situation, its first thought is not anger, but—how to deliver this counterattack."

"He turned to look toward the Tianqing Sect, morning light painting those familiar rooftops gold. Eldest Senior Brother Ling Yuan's residence was deep within the misty clouds, faintly visible. Su Qingyao's inner sect cave dwelling was on the eastern mountainside. And those 'allies' he had 'coincidentally' befriended, those disputes he was 'passively' drawn into—now that he thought about it, which one wasn't being pushed by someone behind the scenes?"

"'The chess player wants to watch me perform, so I will perform for them.' Chen Ji murmured, his voice as calm as an undercurrent in a deep abyss, 'But while acting, I will change the script bit by bit. When they realize something is wrong, the play... will already be out of control.' His gaze fell on the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm, golden patterns faintly visible in the morning light, like a slumbering golden dragon."

"'Seventy-two moves, is that right?' Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of madness, a hint of resolve, 'Then let me see whether you can finish seventy-two moves, or whether I can overturn the chess board at the second move.' He tucked the Tianji Record Fragment into his chest, turned, and strode down the mountain. Morning wind howled, stirring his robes. That once cowardly and mediocre waste servant disciple, his back at this moment was like a sword about to be drawn."

"Just as he was about to step out of the Back Mountain, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly shook violently. That shaking was different from before—not the joy of gaining new abilities, nor the exhaustion of foresight, but a feeling of... being watched. Chen Ji's pupils suddenly constricted—something was trying to read his memories through the Tianji Record."

"Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, slowly turning to look at the rising sun in the east. The sun was beautiful, beautiful like a gentle trap. And in the depths of that light, he seemed to see an invisible eye, coldly watching him. The Heavenly Eye—had it already discovered? Discovered that this once docile chess piece had already grown fangs?"
